help.prefix: Literal start of the key; empty matches every key.
help.glob: * one segment, ** any number of segments, ?, [abc], {a,b}.
help.regex: RE2 syntax, linear time: no backreference nor lookaround. Anchor it with ^ and $.

pattern.unsupported: The browser cannot preview this expression ({{message}}); the server validates it when the rules are saved.

preview.noKeys: Add keys to see which ones the pattern matches.
preview.unsupported: No preview for this expression: the server validates it on save.
preview.invalid: Fix the pattern to see the keys it matches.

accessRules.title: Access rules
accessRules.description: Rules on prefixes, globs and regular expressions of the keys, evaluated by the policy engine with the bucket policy: a deny in any source wins, then an allow grants access.
accessRules.unavailable: You may not manage the access rules of this bucket.
accessRules.conflict: Someone else changed the access rules since they were loaded: nothing was saved. Reload them and apply your change again.
accessRules.empty: No access rule: the bucket policy and the IAM policies decide alone.
accessRules.reorderHint: Drag the rows, or use the arrows, to change the order: the priorities are saved at once.
accessRules.deleteConfirm: Delete the rule {{id}}? The other rules are kept.

editor.priorityHint: Lower first; deny rules before allow rules.
editor.principalsHint: * (everyone, anonymous included), user:name, group:name, accesskey:KEY, distribution:id; * and ? in the names.
editor.publicWarning: This rule grants everyone, anonymous requests included, the actions chosen on the matching keys.
editor.actionsHint: Classes of S3 actions; object lock is never granted.
editor.s3ActionsHint: Explicit actions such as s3:GetObject or s3:Get*.
editor.sampleKeysHint: One per line: keys of the bucket, or keys typed to try the pattern.
editor.previewList: Sample keys and whether the pattern matches them
editor.headersHint: Exact values; ${secret:name} references a secret of the server.
editor.captureHint: Named groups of the regular expression, e.g. (?P<user>[^/]+), and the value they must capture: ${aws:username} gives each user a home directory.

principals.invalid: Use *, user:, group:, accesskey: or distribution:.

issues.ip: {{value}} is neither an IP address nor a CIDR.

timeWindow.order: The start is after the end.

tester.title: Pattern tester
tester.description: Evaluate keys with every source of the policy engine for an identity, an address and a host: the rules each key matches and the final decision.
tester.keysHint: One key per line; none tests the bucket itself.
tester.highlight: Highlight in the table the rules of {{key}}

mismatch.key: The key does not match the pattern.
mismatch.blocked-public: Ignored for everyone: public access is blocked.

tester.noRules: The bucket has no access rule.

code.hint: The document of nexoctl access export / import: saving replaces every rule of the bucket.

presets.title: Public access
presets.description: A preset replaces only the rules it generated (ids preset-*): the rules written by hand are kept.

help.private: No access for everyone: removes every allow rule for everyone.
help.public-read: Anyone may download every object of the bucket.
help.public-read-list: Anyone may download and list every object.
help.public-prefix: Anyone may download the objects of a prefix, glob or regular expression.
help.public-write: Anyone may upload objects: rarely what you want.

warnings.public-read: Every object of the bucket becomes readable without credentials.
warnings.public-read-list: Every object of the bucket and its names become readable without credentials.
warnings.public-prefix: The matching objects become readable without credentials.
warnings.public-write: Anyone on the network can upload to this bucket and fill it: use it only for drop boxes behind other protections.

presets.confirmWrite: I understand that anyone will be able to upload to this bucket
presets.blockedWarning: The block public access is on: the rules of this preset are ignored (or refused in the reject mode).

blockPublic.clusterDescription: On every bucket, the allow rules for everyone are ignored; deny rules still apply.
blockPublic.bucketDescription: The allow rules for everyone of this bucket are ignored; deny rules still apply.
blockPublic.clusterSwitch: Block public access on every bucket
blockPublic.bucketSwitch: Block public access on this bucket

modeHelp.reject: Allow rules for everyone are refused when saved, the stored ones are ignored.
modeHelp.ignore: Allow rules for everyone are accepted but ignored.

blockPublic.clusterOn: The block public access of the cluster is on: it applies to this bucket whatever its own setting.

revealOnce.warning: This is the only time the secret is shown: the server does not keep it in clear. Copy or download it now.
revealOnce.acknowledge: I have stored the secret in a safe place

dns.title: DNS records
dns.targetHint: The host name or the address of the cluster, or of the proxy in front of it.
dns.none: Add domains to see the records to create.
dns.name: Name
dns.apexHint: The apex of a zone (example.com) cannot have a CNAME: use A/AAAA records to the addresses of the target, or the ALIAS/ANAME record of your DNS provider.
dns.verifyHint: The routing table of the cluster decides what each domain serves; requests reach it once the DNS records point to the cluster.

distributions.subtitle: Serve buckets on custom domains, with behaviors per path, signed URLs and TLS.
distributions.forbidden: You may not manage the distributions.
distributions.emptyHint: Create one to serve a bucket on your own domains.
distributions.enabledHint: A disabled distribution refuses every request (403).
distributions.deleteConfirm: Delete the distribution {{id}}? Its domains stop being served at once.
distributions.conflict: Someone else changed this distribution since it was loaded: nothing was saved. Reload it and apply your changes again.

aliasIssue.wildcard: A wildcard is *.<domain> with a domain of at least two labels.

accessHelp.public: Anyone may read, within the deny access rules and the block public access.
accessHelp.signed: A signed URL or signed cookie of a key of the key group is required.
accessHelp.authenticated: S3 credentials (SigV4) or a console session are required.

fields.aliasesHint: Exact names (www.example.com) or wildcards (*.preview.example.com); press Enter after each.

behaviors.title: Behaviors
behaviors.description: Evaluated in order: the first behavior whose pattern matches the path serves the request, otherwise the default behavior.
behaviors.patternRequired: Enter the paths of the behavior.
behaviors.keyGroupRequired: A signed behavior needs a key group.
behaviors.inheritMethods: Inherit the methods of the default behavior
behaviors.methodsHint: POST and PUT only on the signed behaviors of a website distribution.
behaviors.spaHint: Served (200) instead of a missing object.
behaviors.cacheHint: Sent to the browsers; the cache of the distribution has its own policies.
behaviors.corsHint: Origins allowed by CORS on these paths; none inherits the CORS of the distribution.

tester.title: URL tester
tester.description: Which behavior serves this URL, with which access and headers? The server plans the request without reading the object.
tester.unsaved: The tester uses the saved distribution: save your changes to test them.

responses.s3Mode: An S3 distribution answers like the S3 API: error pages and redirects only apply to the website mode.
responses.errorPagesHint: The object served for an error status, and the status answered (e.g. 403 answered as 404 hides the existence of objects).
responses.spaHint: Serve /index.html (200) for the paths that are not objects (single-page applications).
responses.redirectsHint: Evaluated in order: a regular expression on the path ($1, ${name} in the target), a host, or HTTP to HTTPS.
responses.httpsHint: Every HTTP request is redirected to HTTPS.
responses.headersHint: Headers added to every answer; a behavior may add its own.
responses.corsHint: Origins allowed to read the content from a browser script.

security.ipHint: The real address behind the trusted proxies. A denied address is refused; with an allow list, every other address is refused.
security.secretHint: Each proxy sends the secret in a header: the requests without it (direct access bypassing the proxy) are refused. The server keeps only a hash; several secrets stay active during a rotation.
security.keepHint: Kept active until the proxies use the new one.
security.saveFirst: Save or discard your changes before rotating the secret.
security.revealHint: Configure the proxies to send this value in the {{header}} header.
security.rateHint: Requests per second per client address; beyond it the answer is 429.

help.none: The proxy in front of the cluster serves HTTPS.
help.auto: The leader obtains and renews a certificate for the exact domains (Let's Encrypt or another ACME CA); every node serves it.
help.upload: A certificate uploaded in the Certificates section, served by SNI on every node.

traffic.title: Traffic
traffic.unavailable: No statistics: the cache statistics are not available (admin:ManageCache).

document.label: Distribution
document.hint: The document of nexoctl dist export / import. Apply it, then save the changes.
document.applyHint: Applied changes are saved with the save bar.

wizard.title: New distribution
wizard.prefixHint: Optional: the distribution only serves the keys under this prefix (website mode).

issues.id: Enter a valid ID (lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_', '-').
issues.aliases: Add at least one valid domain.
issues.aliasTaken: A domain is already served: remove it or choose another one.

wizard.websiteHint: Static sites and downloads: index document, error pages, SPA fallback, redirects; never S3 XML.
wizard.s3Hint: The domain is an S3 endpoint of the bucket: SDKs use it as their endpoint, presigned URLs carry it.
wizard.s3Note: The S3 mode serves the whole bucket: no path prefix, no website features.
wizard.reviewHint: The distribution to create. Every node routes its domains as soon as it is created.
wizard.createdHint: Create the DNS records below, then verify that the domains reach the distribution.

keyGroups.description: The public keys that verify the signed URLs and cookies of the signed behaviors. Several keys sign at once: add the new key before removing the old one to rotate without downtime.
keyGroups.loadError: Could not load the key groups.
keyGroups.generateHint: The private key is shown once and never stored by the server.
keyGroups.noKeys: No key: the signed URLs of this group cannot be verified.
keyGroups.publicKeyHint: PKIX, Ed25519 or RSA of 2048 to 4096 bits; you keep the private key.
keyGroups.removeKeyConfirm: Remove the key {{key}} of {{group}}? The URLs it signed stop working.
keyGroups.deleteConfirm: Delete the key group {{group}}? A group used by a distribution cannot be deleted.
keyGroups.privateKeyHint: The private key of the key {{key}} of {{group}}: it signs URLs and cookies (CLI, dashboard, SDK).

signing.title: Signed URLs and cookies
signing.description: Sign a URL, or cookies for several files, of a signed behavior with the private key of a key of its key group. The key is used for this signature only and never stored.
signing.noSignedBehavior: No behavior of this distribution is signed: add a signed behavior to generate signed URLs.
signing.urlHint: A path is completed with https://{{host}}.
signing.privateKeyHint: The private key of a key of the key group of the behavior.
signing.resourceHint: A URL with * and ? wildcards, e.g. a whole folder.
signing.cookiesHint: Cookies give access to every file of the resource instead of one URL.

certificates.idHint: Optional: derived from the first DNS name.
certificates.certificatePemHint: The leaf certificate followed by its intermediates.
certificates.privateKeyPemHint: Stored sealed and served by SNI on every node.
certificates.expiringSummary_one: {{count}} certificate expires within {{days}} days or has expired.
certificates.expiringSummary_other: {{count}} certificates expire within {{days}} days or have expired.
certificates.deleteConfirm: Delete the certificate {{id}}? A certificate used by a distribution cannot be deleted.
certificates.acmeHint: Obtained and renewed by the leader for the distributions with an automatic certificate (directory {{directory}}, challenge {{challenge}}).
certificates.acmeEmpty: No distribution uses an automatic certificate.
